snippet_primary: "Payhip is often considered a better alternative to Gumroad for digital creators due to its user-friendly interface, flexible pricing, and added features like built-in affiliate marketing tools. Unlike Gumroad, Payhip's pricing structure is simple and transparent, allowing creators to choose between a free plan with a 5% transaction fee or paid plans with reduced or no transaction fees."
subject_exact: Payhip vs Gumroad positioning and Payhip transaction fee structure (free plan with 5% fee)
local_qualifiers: or paid plans with reduced or no transaction fees
